Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for special hunting season permit preference points.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to special hunting season permit preference points;amending RCW 77.32.370; and adding a new section to chapter 77.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.32.370 and 1998 c 191 s 26 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A special hunting season permit is required to hunt in eachspecial season established under chapter 77.12 RCW. (2) Persons may apply for special hunting season permits asprovided by rule of the commission. (3) The application fee to enter the drawing for a special huntingpermit is five dollars for residents, fifty dollars for nonresidents,and three dollars for youth. (4)(a) The department may award special hunting season permitpreference points, in the manner determined by the department, to aperson applying for a special hunting season permit. (b) The department may conduct special hunting season permitdrawings that provide an applicant who has accumulated preferencepoints with an increased chance of being awarded a special huntingseason permit, in the manner determined by the department. p. 1 SB 5767 (c) Except as provided in section 2 of this act, the department maynot transfer preference points from one person to another.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department may only transfer special hunting season permitpreference points from one person to another as provided undersubsections (2) and (3) of this section. (2) The department shall transfer preference points upon a person'sdeath where: (a) Prior to death, that person requests the transfer of anypreference points accumulated at the time of death to a designatedrecipient. The transfer request must be made in the manner determinedby the department, and must include the signatures of both thetransferor and the designated recipient. The department must maintaina registry containing such request; and (b) Following the death of the transferor, the designated recipientrequests receipt of the preference points in the manner determined bythe department and provides proof of the transferor's death as requiredby the department. (3) The department shall transfer preference points upon a person'sbecoming disabled where a person requests the transfer of anypreference points accumulated. The transfer request must be made inthe manner determined by the department, and must include: Thesignatures of both the transferor and the designated recipient;certification by the transferor that they meet one or more of thecriteria set forth in RCW 79A.05.065(2)(a); and any documentationrequired by the department. A person may only transfer preferencepoints under this subsection once in a lifetime. (4) A designated recipient receiving preference points under thissection retains all preference points that the recipient previouslyaccumulated prior to the transfer. (5) A transferor may not receive any consideration for the transferof preference points. (6) The department may adopt rules as necessary for theadministration of this section.
